constraints.name: p0b_google_bridge_state_json_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (state_json = current_setting('gbrain.p0b.initial_state_json')::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(state_json) = 'object' AND state_json ->> 'fingerprint' = state_fingerprint)

constraints.name: p0b_google_reconciler_checkpoint_lease_ck

constraints.name: p0b_google_embedding_provenance_chunk_fk
